title: [FLINK-39148] [Build] Update flink-connector-kafka & flink-sql-connector-kafka to 4.0.1-2.0
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

flink-connector-kafka 3.0.0-1.17 contains the following CVEs:
* CVE-2025-27819
* CVE-2025-27818
* CVE-2025-27817
* CVE-2024-56128
* CVE-2024-31141
* CVE-2023-44981

Upgrading to 4.0.1-2.0 resolves all above CVEs

## Brief change log

- Update flink-connector-kafka to 4.0.1-2.0
- Update flink-sql-connector-kafka to 4.0.1-2.0
- Use a variable for flink-connector-kafka version

## Verifying this change

Passes CI tests

## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): yes
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: no
  - The serializers: no
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): no
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: no
  - The S3 file system connector: no

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? no
  - If yes, how is the feature documented? not applicable
